prompt: Name one of the original thirteen American colonies.

answers.name: Virginia
answers.fact: The first, founded at Jamestown in 1607, and the largest by population.

answers.name: Massachusetts
answers.fact: Plymouth in 1620, then the much larger Massachusetts Bay a decade later.

answers.name: New York
answers.fact: Dutch until 1664, when the English took it and renamed New Amsterdam.

answers.name: Pennsylvania
answers.fact: Granted to William Penn in 1681 to settle a debt the king owed his father.

answers.name: Georgia
answers.fact: The last, chartered in 1732, and it banned slavery until 1751.

answers.name: Maryland
answers.fact: Chartered in 1632 as a refuge for English Catholics.

answers.name: Connecticut
answers.fact: Its 1639 Fundamental Orders are sometimes called the first written constitution.

answers.name: New Jersey
answers.fact: Split into East and West Jersey for a quarter century before reuniting in 1702.

answers.name: Rhode Island
answers.fact: Founded by Roger Williams after Massachusetts banished him for dissent.

answers.name: North Carolina
answers.fact: Split from South Carolina in 1712 after decades as one unwieldy colony.

answers.name: South Carolina
answers.fact: Built on rice and indigo, and the wealthiest colony per head by 1770.

answers.name: Delaware
answers.fact: Swedish, then Dutch, then English, and it shared Pennsylvania's governor until 1776.

answers.name: New Hampshire
answers.fact: Separated from Massachusetts in 1679, and in January 1776 the first colony to write its own constitution.

distractors.name: Vermont
distractors.note: An independent republic until 1791 - never one of the thirteen.

distractors.name: Florida
distractors.note: Spanish, then British, but never one of the thirteen.

distractors.name: Ohio
distractors.note: Not a colony - it became a state in 1803.
